subjects.name: Computer Organization
subjects.description: Digital data representation, CPU architecture, memory hierarchy, I/O organization, and pipelining fundamentals.

topics.title: Unit 1 — Introduction & Physical Data Handling
topics.summary: Functional units of a computer, number systems, Boolean algebra, logic gates, and combinational circuits.

topics.title: Unit 2 — The Central Processing Unit
topics.summary: Registers, the instruction cycle, instruction set architecture, addressing modes, and control unit design.

topics.title: Unit 3 — Memory Organization
topics.summary: Memory hierarchy, RAM/ROM, cache mapping techniques, and secondary storage.

topics.title: Unit 4 — Input/Output Organization
topics.summary: I/O devices, programmed I/O, interrupt-driven I/O, and Direct Memory Access (DMA).

topics.title: Unit 5 — Assembly Language & Advanced Concepts
topics.summary: Assembly language basics, instruction pipelining, and a system-level course review.
